The '''Conjo Y41-C2LC fighter''' was a type of [[Conjo fighter]] built by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] for planetary defense forces. The Y41-C2LC's armaments of twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and twelve [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], with ranges of 800 and 700 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] respectively, made it a useful ground attack craft against fortified military bases.<ref name="TABSB" />
